purpose: Provider-neutral payment, verification and entitlement lifecycle
transition_rules: ORDER_PENDING -> AWAITING_PAYMENT only after server resolves canonical product, active price, currency and amount
AWAITING_PAYMENT -> PROVIDER_PENDING only after server creates an idempotent payment intent
PROVIDER_PENDING -> VERIFICATION_PENDING when provider returns or sends a callback/webhook
VERIFICATION_PENDING -> PAYMENT_VERIFIED only after server independently verifies provider authenticity, reference, amount, currency and final payment status
PAYMENT_VERIFIED -> FULFILLING only from persisted verified payment state
FULFILLING -> COMPLETED only after the intended entitlement or service fulfillment is persisted
Any unpaid pre-verification state -> FAILED or CANCELLED without granting entitlement
PAYMENT_VERIFIED or COMPLETED -> REFUND_PENDING only through an authenticated server-side refund workflow
REFUND_PENDING -> REFUNDED only after provider/server refund confirmation and required entitlement reconciliation
invariant_rules: Browser redirect, query string, local storage and client JavaScript never establish payment truth
Client never supplies authoritative amount, currency, provider key, price id or entitlement
Provider selection is server-side and market-aware
Every payment intent has an idempotency key
Entitlement can be granted only from persisted PAYMENT_VERIFIED state
Webhook or callback processing is idempotent and auditable
Provider secrets and webhook secrets never enter Git or browser code
Refund and reversal processing must reconcile affected entitlement state
